text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
—— How many years… no,
perhaps it was centuries ago. 
All things drift from me… but yes,
I remember now.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
On Hallowe'en,
the village welcomes souls from beyond, 
extending a warm welcome to humans and demons
alike.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
But it's always the same.
They gather to talk about the dead. 
It got tiresome,
and I found myself wandering the village……

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
That mansion had long since fallen to ruin,
devoid of 
human presence… yet a feast now laid
prepared.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
Someone… no, something is there. 
Something awaits the return of the
deceased…

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
At first glance,
it's unmistakably "not alive". 
Yet, it's also "not dead"…

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text: —— Uninvited guest, who might you be?

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
And "what" are you? 
State your name.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
I bear no name. I am a <Mechanical Doll>, 
as documented in my blueprint.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text: <Mechanical Doll>?

text_block_list.name: [Creator]
text_block_list.text: "A creation comprised of patched flesh and machinery, with oil flowing like blood through its veins. Astonishingly, it is able to understand and articulate speech."

text_block_list.name: [Creator]
text_block_list.text: "My magnum opus in this lifetime! And an enduring, historic sin… for I have given birth to an empty monster."

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
…… Ah,
I understand now. Those who seek to 
play God can be found throughout every
era.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
It appears you're a well-known demon. 
I believe your realm must house my
creator.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
I have a request.
Would you please bring my creator to me?

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
For a 100 years,
I have awaited my master's visit on this
night. My creator,
who passed away immediately after my
birth.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
I simply wish to meet them. 
I desire to know…… the purpose of my
existence.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Life has no meaning. 
You are born,
and you disappear. That is all.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
But I do not possess life. 
I am a creation of clear intention.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
For 100 years… I have pondered relentlessly.
Yet, even with 
my intellect, pride of my master,
the reason eludes me.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
Demon,
I implore you.
Could you grant my wish and reunite 
me with my creator?
I will give you anything you wish.

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
No, I refuse.
I have no interest in taking anything from
you. 
My desire lies solely with the souls of the
living…

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
… However,
I may consider searching for your so-called
creator. 
But you must bring me… the finest, pure,
white soul.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
You mean… You want me to take another's
life?

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
Ha! The lonely monster hesitates? 
They aren't your "friends" or anything,
are they?

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
Think about it with your cherished intellect.
A hundred years of 
seeking the reason to your existence,
versus the life of someone 
who doesn't even know it… which is more
valuable?

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
The deadline is until this ludicrous Hallowe'en
concludes. Of course,
you won't be able to roam the town any
later, 
will you? I'm looking forward to it… Haha!

text_block_list.name: [Demon]
text_block_list.text:
—— For the first time in a century,
the monster descended 
to the village. Among the costumed villagers,
its patched 
appearance didn't stand out. However…

text_block_list.name: [Villager A]
text_block_list.text:
Hey look,
a new face. Have they always been here? 
… They seem rather eerie, don't they?

text_block_list.name: [Villager B]
text_block_list.text:
Probably a traveller.
Our village's festival has quite a
reputation. 
But…… what a strange disguise.
Almost as if a monster…

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
I must bring that demon… a pure white
soul ——

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
—— Oh? 
Hello there!

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
What an amazing costume! 
What's your name?

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
Don't want to say? That's fine,
we'll keep it a secret between us! 
Even without knowing names,
we can still be friends.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
Friends…… 
…… Me, and you?

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right. 
―― Nice to meet you, friend!

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
There is no way to know the color of a soul.
But for some 
reason,
I am certain her soul's color is pure and
white.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
—— Are you searching for clover here? 
It's futile.
Nothing grows in such a barren land.

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, let's see about that! 
Come on, instead of just standing there,
lend me a hand!

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
After we're done,
let's enjoy some cake together! I baked 
a delicious Barmbrack.
It'll be your reward if you find one!

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
—— Friends, until Hallowe'en ends. 
Until Hallowe'en ends… and after that…

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text: —— This is…

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
Proof that clovers can grow in this
wasteland! 
I also found some in the past,
under a boulder!

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text:
… No, it can't be. It is documented 
that there are no clover in this place.

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
It's true! I touched them,
confirmed their existence, 
in my eyes, my hands, my heart!

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
Hey, have you never left this village
before? 
This world is filled with things you can't
learn from books!

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
You see,
my dream is to travel the world and see lots
of clovers! 
When that time comes,
you should come with me.

text_block_list.name: [Mechanical Doll]
text_block_list.text: …… Why me?

text_block_list.name: [Young Girl]
text_block_list.text:
Because it's more fun with friends! 
―― Let's promise!
